item.title: Dresden Middle’s Becca Steele named semifinalist for national award
item.description: Becca Steele, band director and music teacher at Dresden Middle School, has been named a semifinalist for the prestigious CMA Foundation Music Teachers of Excellence Award.

item.title: Man accused of pretending to be an officer to steal doughnuts from gas station
item.description: A Kentucky man is facing charges after police say he walked into an area gas station and flashed a fake badge to steal coffee and doughnuts.

item.title: Looking for retail deals? Now’s the time as peak seasons end
item.description: For small businesses and corporations alike, January sales tend to slow down. Even so, clearance deals are ramping up to make room for new merchandise.
